title: Jadh Ghazi Jakay Samm Gaya Loko
body:
Jadh Ghazi Jakay Samm Gaya Loko, Nehar Kinaray
<<DIVIDER>>
Chadraa Di Zamanat Moar Laye Zainab Nay
Sab Pardedara Ton, Haye Tuttay Maan Nay Sara.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Allah Zainab Tay Ay Kinjh Da Vela Ageya
Aj Bhen Athara Veeran Di Maqtal Vich
Baywarisa Wang Khaloti, Haye Raye Koyi Na Saharay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Day Jhulay Nu Ro Ro Kay Sakina Vaikh Di
Kaddi Darr Khaimay Tay Jakay Nehar Day Pasay
Mu Karkay Dukhiyari, Haye Chachay Nu Pukaray.
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar Day Lashay Nu Mazloom Hattha Tay Cha Khara
Peya Sochda Hay Kiwain Tapdiyan Raitan Day Vich
Is Jigaar Day Tukray Di, Haye Mayyat Nu Utaray.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad Aondi Karbal Di Akhtar Parcham Val Vaikh Kay
Jado Alam Da Paak Pharera Naal Hawa Day
Haar Moman Day Ghaar Tay, Haye Lenda Ay Hularay.
